name: s2j-similarity-service
description: A pure PHP library for semantic similarity detection
author: Koutarou ISHIKAWA

scripts.install:docs-linter_compat: cd tools/docs-linter && npx -y npm@11.11.0 run install:compat
scripts.prelint:docs: cd tools/docs-linter && git restore . && cd ../.. && git submodule update --remote --merge && cd tools/docs-linter && (npm ci --workspaces=false --include-workspace-root=false || (rm -f package-lock.json && npm install --workspaces=false --include-workspace-root=false)) && npm run build && cd node_modules/textlint-rule-preset-wp-docs-ja && (npm install --workspaces=false --include-workspace-root=false || true) && (test -f vite.config.ts || test -f vite.config.js) && npm run build || true && cd ../../..
scripts.prelint:docs_compat: cd tools/docs-linter && git restore . && cd ../.. && git submodule update --remote --merge && cd tools/docs-linter && (npx -y npm@11.11.0 ci --workspaces=false --include-workspace-root=false || (rm -f package-lock.json && npx -y npm@11.11.0 run install:compat)) && npx -y npm@11.11.0 run build && cd node_modules/textlint-rule-preset-wp-docs-ja && (npx -y npm@11.11.0 install --workspaces=false --include-workspace-root=false || true) && (test -f vite.config.ts || test -f vite.config.js) && npx -y npm@11.11.0 run build || true && cd ../../..
